name: Clif Bar Baking Co. of Twin Falls - Twin Falls ID

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to the Clif Bar bakery in the Jayco Industrial Park, area of Champlin Rd & Eldridge Ave, southeast Twin Falls (street address 3438 Eldridge Ave, ZIP 83341 per Waze listing). Roster city-centroid coords (42.5826,-114.4286) were ~5km NW in a residential/farm area; corrected via web research (Idaho Commerce, BoiseDev, Magic Valley) plus satellite confirmation of the distinctive ~275,000 sq ft biophilic-design plant with on-site solar arrays.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint pinch-point visible at any driveway. The site sits on a ~90-acre standalone parcel with wide-open undeveloped buffer land; access roads are part of the industrial-park network and run open into the property. Classified false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure visible anywhere along the access roads or at the building. False.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — no gate present, so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Covered dock canopy on the west building face; ~9 trailers backed in / parked at the dock line. Total dock-door count ~8-12, banded 0-10 (low confidence — partly shadowed). Bulk-bar bakery, modest dock count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop trailers staged along the north/east internal access road plus the open yard west of the dock; estimated 10-25 trailer capacity.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved aprons and abundant unused paved width around the building loop — ample room to add express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal loop road from the park network to the dock can hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town isolated industrial site surrounded by farmland and open scrub; Rural.
fieldNotes.imagery: Street View at the property dates to 2012 (pre-construction empty land) so gate determination relies on current satellite (Maxar 2026), which is clear.
